steps.label: Talk to Scott
steps.objective: Talk to Lt Scott in the Gate Room.

steps.label: Find Rush
steps.objective: Find Dr Rush in the Control Interface Room.

steps.label: Find a place to rest
steps.objective: Find a place to rest. Try your quarters.

steps.label: Inspect the strange device
steps.objective: There's a strange device on your desk. Take a look.

steps.label: Sleep
steps.objective: Get some rest. Lay down on the bed in your quarters.

steps.label: Return to the Control Room
steps.objective: Scott's orders: get to the Control Interface Room and find Rush.

steps.label: Access a control terminal
steps.objective: Access a control terminal in the Control Interface Room.

steps.label: Find CO2 scrubber
steps.objective: Talk to Dr Rush at the open life-support panel in the south corridor.

steps.label: Trigger FTL drop
steps.objective: Return to the Gate Room and trigger the FTL drop.

steps.label: Get to the Gate Room
steps.objective: Dr Brody says the gate dialed itself. Get to the Gate Room.

steps.label: Fetch a Kino
steps.objective: We can't risk going in blind. Grab a Kino from the dispenser in your quarters.

steps.label: Send a Kino through the gate
steps.objective: Back at the gate: open the Kino Remote (Tab) and launch a Kino through to scout the planet.

steps.label: Dial lime planet
steps.objective: Use Gate Control in the Gate Room to dial the lime planet.

steps.label: Mine lime
steps.objective: Step through the Stargate and mine lime on the planet.

steps.label: Return to Destiny
steps.objective: Return through the planet gate to Destiny.

steps.label: Repair CO2 scrubber
steps.objective: Bring lime to the CO2 scrubber in the south corridor.

steps.label: Unlock more of the ship
steps.objective: Salvage parts from broken panels and unlock the next deck of Destiny via the floor terminal.

steps.label: Exploration underway
steps.objective: The ship's secrets are yours to uncover.
